column1: # A proposition, evidence for it, and whether the checker accepts it. Read by
# kernel_check_edges_test, which checks each with the kernel, and by
# tools/formal/check.sh, which states each verdict as a Coq Example about the
# model's checker (formal/coq/Checker.v with the normalizer of Normalize.v and
# the arithmetic of Linear.v) proven by computation. The two agreeing on every
# row is evidence that the model checks what the kernel checks: every rule, its
# acceptances and its near misses (docs/KERNEL.md 17); neither side reads the
# other.
# Prefix notation, tokens separated by spaces. A type is uN or iN. A term is vN
# (the Nth binder from the innermost), type:value, or a primitive's name, its
# type and its operands. A proposition is eq type term term, all type P,
# imp P P, and P P, or P P, or false. Evidence is refl, alli type E,
# alle P E term, hyp N (the Nth hypothesis from the newest), impi P E,
# impe P E E, eqe type term term P E E (the motive's hole is v0),
# cond type term term term P E E, lin N followed by N facts each P E and a
# certificate, andi E E, ande P E side, ori E side, ore P E E E, falsee E, or
# ind type E E; a side is left or right. A certificate is farkas N followed by
# N position:multiplier pairs, split N followed by N variable:coefficient pairs,
# a constant and two certificates, or cases N followed by two certificates.
# proposition
column2: evidence
